types.name: The Quiet Gatekeeper
types.line: Labels nobody at the party can name, bought on repeat and never once explained

types.name: The Sale Romantic
types.line: Falls hard for whatever just got marked down, anywhere on the internet, and somehow it all works out

types.name: The Creature of Habit
types.line: Same store, same kind of thing, every time, and honestly the system is undefeated

types.name: The Archive Diver
types.line: Cult labels at friendly prices, found three pages deep in a search most people would have abandoned

types.name: The Full-Price Purist
types.line: Classic labels at full price with no waiting around for a sale that was never part of the plan

types.name: The Store Hopper
types.line: A different checkout every time, and the order history reads like a travel diary

types.name: The Uniform
types.line: Found the formula a long time ago and has been quietly restocking it ever since

types.name: The Trend Sprinter
types.line: Always on this season's thing and already halfway to next season's

types.name: The Heritage Head
types.line: Sticks to the classics so firmly that trends just bounce off

types.name: The Bargain Bloodhound
types.line: Can smell a markdown from three tabs away

types.name: The Luxury Loyalist
types.line: One very nice store, full price, every time, no notes

types.name: The Esoteric Explorer
types.line: Twelve labels deep and each one harder to pronounce than the last

types.name: The Chaos Collector
types.line: No two orders look like they came from the same closet, which is exactly the charm

types.name: The Steady Classicist
types.line: Knows exactly what works and sees no reason to discuss it further

types.name: The Sale-Rack Scholar
types.line: Knows the cult labels and also knows exactly when they go on sale

types.name: The Investment Piece
types.line: Nicer labels at full price, every single time, zero haggling

types.name: The Mall Marathoner
types.line: Has done a lap of the whole mall and checked out at most of it

types.name: The Comfort Zone
types.line: Found the good basics store early and saw no reason to leave

types.name: The Wildcard
types.line: Every order is a plot twist, and the plot is mostly markdowns

types.name: The Curator
types.line: One very curated store doing a lot of heavy lifting for a very particular closet

types.name: The Classic With a Secret
types.line: Classic everything until the labels come out and nobody has heard of any of them

types.name: The Sale Strategist
types.line: Knows exactly when one particular store marks things down and is ready at the refresh

types.name: The Middle Path
types.line: Perfectly balanced on every slider, which is either very zen or very suspicious

types.name: The Blank Canvas
types.line: Not enough receipts to read yet, which is its own kind of mystery
